title: Sunspot Watch
text:
☀️ Sunspot Watch — October 19, 2026

NOAA Active Region 4551 stands out on the visible solar disk today as a sunspot region associated with recent M-class activity.

📍 Location: S15W59
☀️ Region: AR 4551
🔥 Recent activity: 1 M-class flare · 2 C-class flares

Sunny has spots. This seems unfair.

Sunspots are cooler, magnetically active regions of the solar surface and are often associated with solar flares and other activity.

Images: NASA SDO/HMI — Continuum Intensity, Intensitygram (Flattened), Intensitygram
Data: NOAA Space Weather Prediction Center + NASA SDO
